title: React ES6 Array Methods
text:
React ES6 Array Methods Array Methods There are many JavaScript array methods. One of the most useful in React is the .map() array method. The .map() method allows you to run a function on each item in the array, returning a new array as the result. In React, map() can be used to generate lists.
